verdict: CLEAR for the additive Select composition adapter only

implementation_review.API: Additive select function; borrowed component/configuration/state/items. Existing signatures and existing adapters unchanged. Same configured component used for measure and draw. No additional trait or input system.
implementation_review.measurement: SelectLeaf delegates existing Select::measure (fixed intrinsic 12/24 columns by one row, fit constraints); no draw, handlers, domain actions, item scans, state mutation, cursor registration, or layer opening.
implementation_review.rendering: SelectLeaf delegates existing Select::draw with resolved logical rectangle inside existing composition clip; shared Select retains registration, layer scope, popup rendering, styles, cursor and actions. Ui::layer deliberately switches to popup clip.
implementation_review.ownership: No application source dependencies, raw painting, reference imports, copied widget mechanics, unsafe code, synchronization or failure recovery added. Existing fallible Group measurement/show return propagation unchanged.
implementation_review.compatibility: Existing production behavior unchanged unless the new adapter is called; direct Select and composed Select compared through complete decoded Buffer and runtime state at matched dimensions/input histories.
